r: support.message: I don't do support here. If a patch is misbehaving, file a bug report.

r: app-side.message: The stock app does this too. Reopen if the patched build behaves differently.

r: not-this-bundle.message: That APK wasn't built from this bundle. Patch it yourself with Morphe Manager or morphe-cli and report again if it still happens.

r: app-updated.message: That version isn't targeted yet. Use a listed one, or leave this open and I'll retarget when I can.

r: server-side.message: The server enforces this. Nothing in the APK to patch.

r: no-repro.message: I can't reproduce this. Add exact steps and the patch list from the app's entry in Morphe Manager.

r: fixed.message: Fixed in the next release. Repatch when it lands and reopen if it still happens.

r: not-a-bug.message: Not a patch bug. Reopen if it comes back.
